messages:
maria (PM): quick one — saved views in console: should the default scope be model-aware? i.e., when someone saves a view from a route that currently points at a canary model, do we bind the saved view to that exact model-version or to the logical route?
aj (Eng): my take: we need both options. backend-wise we store an explicit scope array. example:```
{
  "name": "Checkout latency - canary",
  "scope": ["route:/checkout/price", "model:llama-70b-v1"],
  "inherit": "team", // org | team | personal
  "meta": { "sample_rate": 0.1 }
}
```
devon (Design): +1 for exposing the choice but pls avoid extra clicks. UX suggestion: active-pill shows "route" and an optional "model" badge when the saved view is pinned to a version. add a small "Make model-tied" toggle in the save modal.
sam (Analytics): important: if we tie to model-version we must snapshot the telemetry sampling info and metric buckets. otherwise a saved view later will show misleading trends when sample rates changed. store: `sample_rate`, `aggregation_window`, and `telemetry_version` in meta.
aj (Eng): agreed. implementation note: saved views must be immutable (create -> versioned updates) so dashboards that reference them don't get surprise changes. internal API sketch: POST /api/v1/savedviews {name, scope[], meta{}, visibility} -> returns id+version. queries then accept `view_id` or `scope` fallback.
maria (PM): question on permissions/quotas: if a saved view is team-visible and references a costly model, do we show quota impact or routing hints? thinking of a "cost preview" and a "route hint` that says "may trigger canary model routing".
infra-bot: note: exposing routing hints requires plumbing from router -> console. we already surface routing policies in /routes API but not per-savedview. we can add `expose_routing_hint: true|false` to meta and surface a small warning in the modal.
devon (Design): UI wrap-up: default save flow = "save as route-scoped" (no model badge), advanced toggle = "bind to model" (adds model badge + cost preview). keep primary CTA single "Save".
aj (Eng): i'll open a tiny RFC + wire up the API prototype. will include example payloads and migration plan for existing saved queries.
maria (PM): awesome — assign RFC to aj, devon for prototype, sam for telemetry contract. thanks :thumbsup:
